name: @astra-spec/astra-theme
description: MyST article and book themes for ASTRA publications, using the resolved SDK contract, shared ASTRA UI, and Lightcone brand.

scripts.build: npm run build:article && npm run build:book

comments.overrides: Force a single React 19 across the whole tree — jupyterlab/thebe deps pull React 18, which would bundle multiple React copies into the server build and break SSR hooks. Mirrors @myst-theme upstream.
comments.myst-theme-site-patch: @myst-theme/site 1.3.1 types its mutation-observer ref for pre-React-19 RefObject semantics. The isolated patch permits the null current value required by this repo's React 19 override.
comments.postinstall: The empty themes/*/node_modules dirs make a built local checkout directly usable as site.template: myst skips its template install step when node_modules exists (deps are hoisted to the repo root).
comments.tabbable: @jupyter/web-components imports tabbable without declaring it. The removed floating-card dependency used to hoist it accidentally, so keep it explicit for reproducible Remix builds.
